Congress to Oppose Bill on Dismissal of Jailed Ministers

The Congress party has announced its intention to strongly oppose a proposed constitutional amendment bill. This bill, if passed, would lead to the dismissal of ministers and chief ministers from their positions if they remain in custody for 30 days, particularly for serious offenses. The party has labeled the proposed legislation as 'dangerous'.
